i think its the future stuff. like everyone my age seems to have it figured out and im 29 and i just. dont. i left my job in march to try to freelance and its not really working and i havent told my parents the full picture yet. theres this part of me thats embarrassed im even still trying and another part thats terrified i waited too long to do something else. both at the same time if that makes sense
That makes a lot of sense — it sounds like embarrassment and fear are both here, and they’re tangled together. Is one of them louder right now, or do they feel equally close?

ugh i think the embarrassment is louder honestly. like the fear is there underneath but the thing that keeps me up is imagining my sister at thanksgiving asking how the freelance thing is going and me having to do the whole oh its picking up smile. shes a nurse, shes got the house, the whole thing. and i used to be the one everyone thought would do something big and now i just feel like i fumbled it. like i had all this potential and wasted it. sorry this is a lot im just typing whatever comes out
No need to apologize — I’m hearing something sharp and exposed in that. Does it feel more like wanting to hide, or more like wanting to explain yourself?

hiding for sure. like i literally screen my mums calls sometimes because i dont want to get into it. and the explaining feels pointless cause whatever i say sounds like an excuse even to me. i keep thinking if id just stuck it out at the old job id at least be normal right now. but i also hated that job. so its like i cant even feel sorry for myself cleanly lol. theres always a but

heavy and tight i think. like in my chest. its weird seeing it laid out like that, self critical, yeah thats the word for it. i dont actually think i wasted my whole life its just the voice in my head gets really loud at night. i dunno. i think i needed to just say it to something that wasnt gonna tell me to update my linkedin lol
